description:
Activate Mimeoplasm by paying {2}, causing it to become a copy of Gyre Sage.
Activate Mimeoplasm by tapping it, adding at least seven {G}.
Activate Mimeoplasm by paying {2}, causing it to become a copy of Gilder Bairn.
Activate Mimeoplasm using Gilder Bairn's ability by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it.
Repeat.

uses.name: Mimeoplasm, Revered One
uses.cardState: without summoning sickness and with seven or more +1/+1 counters on it
